summary: Market mood is mixed to cautious: Bitcoin faces conflicting signals, with bearish rollover concerns from Bloomberg Intelligence’s Mike McGlone versus a possible new four-year bull cycle from Fidelity’s Jurrien Timmer.[9] Ethereum is directionless in the near term, while higher-timeframe dips may offer buying opportunities; commodities remain firm, with Brent crude and gold elevated.[4][2]
